_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Proposes OCDM-based FMCW ISAC for FSO. Dedicates one subcarrier for FMCW ranging, others for comms. Achieves Gbps rates and cm-level accuracy.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Figure 2: System schematic showing OCDM transmitter and FMCW ranging receiver. Figure 3: Time-frequency diagram showing guard bands. Figures 5-8: Ranging results. Figures 9-11: Communication BER/EVM.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: FSO ISAC. Modulation: OCDM (Orthogonal Chirp Division Multiplexing). Sensing: FMCW LiDAR (using one subcarrier). Detection: Coherent (for sensing), IM/DD (for comms - implied by setup description 'coherent demodulation' but text mentions 'direct detection' advantages in intro, however experiment uses coherent detection for sensing and communication data retrieval). *Wait, section III says: 'received communication data ... coherently demodulated'.*
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 3.182 Gbps (64-QAM). EVM ~5.8%. BER analysis vs Turbulence. Sensing: Beat frequency linearity R^2=1. Residual error < 0.1m (10cm). Precision < 1mm deviation vs standard FMCW.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Innovative use of OCDM for FSO-ISAC. Solves the tradeoff between high-speed comms and precise ranging by spectral allocation (subcarrier reservation) with guard bands.

bibliographic.title: OCDM-Based FMCW Waveform Design for FSO Integrated Sensing and Communications
bibliographic.authors: Zhengchao Ban, Jingbo Tang, Qijie Xie, Yichuan Li

application.scenario_description: FSO link supporting simultaneous high-speed data and FMCW LiDAR ranging.

key_contribution.key_contribution: OCDM-FMCW waveform design dedicating a subcarrier for ranging.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Low data rates in existing FSO-ISAC and poor ranging accuracy in multi-carrier schemes.

transmitter.notes: AWG generates OCDM (1024 subcarriers). 512th subcarrier used for ranging. MZM modulation.

receiver.notes: Coherent detection for both comms and sensing (beat frequency extraction).

waveform.notes: OCDM uses chirps as subcarriers. Comm data on most subcarriers, Sensing on one dedicated subcarrier.

channel_fibre.notes: Fiber delay line used to mimic FSO delay in lab.

channel_wireless.notes: Simulated Gamma-Gamma turbulence and lab fiber delay (up to 15m) for ranging proof.

comm_metrics.notes: 3.182 Gbps with 64-QAM. 6 Gbps max theoretical capacity simulated.

sensing_metrics.notes: Centimeter-level accuracy (<0.1m residual error). 15m max delay tested in lab.

tradeoff.notes: Guard band length tradeoffs: larger guard band = better ranging (less interference) but lower comm capacity.
